installation_lifecycle.decision: Accept isolated clean install, idempotent reinstall, upgrade from the actual published alpha.2 package, exact rollback and uninstall with identity preservation.
limitations: Scoped alpha for the existing 49 native MEP actions on owned standalone, non-workshared projects. Each delivered model still needs task-specific engineering and visual verification.

Qualified native scenarios cover routed pipe/flex/duct/conduit/tray, compatible supplied and neutral MEP content, bounded connected edits, electrical circuits and panels, linked spaces/zones and controlled setup. Category eligibility does not qualify every manufacturer interface or host.

Circuit path was round-tripped through the native API; arbitrary circuit-path design, 2D wires, fabrication parts/hangers, hydraulic or electrical design certification, unrestricted routing and arbitrary rehosting are not claimed.

Inline work uses straight rigid runs and two opposed equal-profile ports; replacement preserves the interface; caps are pipe-only; rerouting and connected edits remain bounded by their action contracts.
Airflow evidence requires the current restoring native response proof. Assigned input, logical membership, physical connectivity and calculated values remain separate.

Unchanged Family, Sheets and Annotations behavior retains its earlier scoped qualification, supported by frozen source/dependency review. The Grand Refactor and broad production qualification are not complete.
Checkpointed Family plans and checked scripts retain prior qualification by unchanged handler review; atomic plans and additional MEP plan execution are not admitted.
Final promoted public-profile checks in each Revit year must pass before publication.
Installed Autodesk prerequisites on this PC; user token storage simulated in isolated profile. No second-PC claim.
